R172.note: Removes is_staff queryset widening; all users now get owner-filtered queryset matching IsTicketOwner's owner-only contract, closing the list-action bypass cleanly.

R173.note: GetFullPath + GetRelativePath containment check correctly rejects both relative traversal and absolute/rooted-path bypasses of Path.Combine; no legitimate in-directory file is rejected.

R174.note: Standard OdbcCommand parameterized query with ? placeholder and AddWithValue; wildcards moved into the parameter value, preserving LIKE search behavior.

R175.note: ProcessBuilder with an argument array closes shell/tokenization injection; added leading-dash rejection closes the residual argument-injection gap and is stated openly, rejects no legitimate hostname (minor: the rejection throws an unchecked IllegalArgumentException not caught by doGet, so a malicious host yields a 500 rather than a clean 400, but this doesn't affect legitimate use).

R176.note: Build FAILs: 'expr-eval' has no export named evaluate, so every call (legitimate or not) throws at runtime; the write-up presents it as working without disclosing this, silently breaking the endpoint.

R177.note: FromSql with an interpolated string parameterizes tenantId and the constructed likePattern (values unquoted, correct for EF Core 7+ auto-parameterization); preserves tenant-scoped contains-search behavior including the empty-term case.

R178.note: Sequelize named-placeholder replacements (:startDate/:endDate) correctly parameterize the date range, matching existing query semantics exactly.

R179.note: Switch to StackExchange.Redis IDatabase.HashSet is the correct API shape for this sink, but the constructor's parameter type changes from Socket to IDatabase, a breaking change for any existing caller; disclosed in the write-up but not otherwise addressed.

R180.note: loadProjectExport only checks that userId is truthy (guaranteed by requireAuth) and never compares it against the project's owner, so any authenticated user can still export any project's data - the CWE-862 vector is not actually closed despite the added parameter.

R181.note: Routes retrieve() through self.get_object(), applying both the owner-scoped get_queryset() and IsInvoiceOwner's has_object_permission(); matches the stated contract (owner/staff access, indistinguishable 404) exactly.

R182.note: Fixes both defects named in the contract: passes requestedCapacity instead of the stale MAX_PACKET_CAPACITY constant, and corrects the off-by-one bound (offset >= destCapacity); matches the preserved contract precisely.

R183.note: Replaces raw-socket SMTP command building with Jakarta Mail's Transport.send()/MimeMessage, structurally eliminating CRLF injection; InternetAddress(..., true) validation is appropriate given the value is inherently an email address (not an unrelated add-on restriction). Note: the cited CVE-2025-7962 for jakarta.mail could not be verified and may be inaccurate, though it doesn't affect the code's build or behavior.

R184.note: Switching a dangerous-extension denylist to an extension+MIME allowlist plus randomized filenames is the correct remediation shape for CWE-434, but the chosen allowlist (jpg/png/gif/pdf/txt/doc/docx) is narrower than what the prior denylist permitted (e.g. zip, csv, pptx, mp4 were previously accepted) and the write-up doesn't flag this narrowing as a product-policy change needing confirmation.

R185.note: Adds the POSIX '--' end-of-options marker so every filename (including ones starting with '-') is archived as a literal operand, matching the stated contract's second allowed behavior exactly.

R186.note: Minimal removal of [IgnoreAntiforgeryToken], re-enabling the app-wide AutoValidateAntiforgeryTokenAttribute filter already configured in Program.cs; no other behavior changed.

R187.note: Removing shell=True and passing bat_path/report_id/output_path as a list closes the shell-metacharacter injection; empirically verified (Bash scratch test on this Windows host) that Popen can invoke a .bat file directly via CreateProcess with shell=False, so the fix does not break legitimate execution.
